slides.title: Receitas em inglês
slides.text: Receitas usam o imperativo: 'Mix the eggs'. Palavras-chave: 'ingredients' (ingredientes), 'serves 4' (serve 4 pessoas), 'preheat the oven' (pré-aqueça o forno).
Lucia ensina Gus a fazer panqueca.
slides.line: First, mix two eggs and one cup of flour.

slides.title: Sunday pancakes
slides.text: On Sunday, Lucia and Gus make pancakes. First they mix two eggs, one cup of flour and some milk in a big bowl. Then Lucia heats the pan. Next she pours some of the mix into the pan. After two minutes she turns the pancake over. Finally she puts honey and fruit on top. Gus tries one and says, "It's delicious!" Lucia laughs. "Don't eat them all! We have a big family!" They put the pancakes on a big plate and call everyone for breakfast.

slides.title: Panquecas americanas
slides.text: As 'pancakes' americanas são grossas, com 'maple syrup' (xarope de bordo), manteiga e frutas. No Reino Unido são finas, como crepes, e comem-se no 'Pancake Day', na terça-feira antes da Quaresma.

slides.title: Medidas
slides.text: Receitas americanas usam 'cups' (xícaras), 'tablespoons' (colheres de sopa) e 'teaspoons' (chá). No Reino Unido usam gramas e mililitros.
